deskyard guide: short manual for environment access and control

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] guide

Prints a short manual: how an environment is laid out, the three ways to work
(shell, browser, desktop) and when to use which.

Prints: the guide

Examples:
  deskyard guide

Where: on this machine (no server needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
